michelle_prod: Quick heads-up — we just opened a limited H100 Dedicated pool in us-east-1 (zones a & b) and started accepting reservation requests.

devin_infra: Details: initial capacity = 12 H100 GPUs per zone. Soft per-account quota = 6 GPUs/zone. If you need >6, file a support quota request (select 'Dedicated GPU quota - H100') — expect ~72h review for accel increases.

laura_sales: Noted. Which customers get priority for the early capacity? Any migration credits or discounts we should offer?

michelle_prod: Priority order: 1) existing Dedicated customers with active commitments, 2) enterprise accounts on Enterprise SLO plan, 3) selected pilot partners. No blanket credits for the initial rollout — we'll handle exceptions via AMs. Sales playbook link posted in #sales-docs.

infra-bot: Pool health check: region us-east-1a/us-east-1b reported. p95 token-latency = 42ms, p99 = 58ms, avg util = 61%. No failed nodes.

zach_ops: FYI there is a scheduled maintenance window Sun 2026-03-29 02:00-03:30 UTC to deploy driver/kernel updates. We'll do staggered zone maintenance with automatic cross-zone routing; degradation should be minimal. If you rely on single-zone placement, consider enabling cross-zone redundancy or temporary fallback to L4 families.

michelle_prod: Action items: (1) eng-infra to add an alert for cross-zone depletion (pager if pool drops below 20% spare GPUs) — @devin_infra, (2) ops to add fallback policy document and update playbook — @zach_ops, (3) AMs: start outreach to top 20 Dedicated customers this morning.

devin_infra: Will add the alert and a CLI flag --prefer-zone for the CLI/reservation API. Also adding an API field reservation_type: "soft-hold" vs "hard-reserve" to help prioritize migration flows.

michelle_prod: Docs (internal): https://internal.redwood.com/docs/dedicated/h100-us-east — includes pricing, quota request form, migration checklist, and maintenance schedule. If you have customers who need immediate capacity, route them to support with the quota request link and tag #dedicated-ops.

laura_sales: I'm looping in AMs now. Thanks!

zach_ops: I'll post a quick incident playbook update in #eng-oncall for the maintenance. If anyone sees unexpected evictions or slow routing, ping me directly.

michelle_prod: Thanks team :rocket: — we'll post an external customer announcement once we've validated the first 48h of pool stability. For questions, continue replies here or DM.
